hero.title: Making Travel in Sri Lanka Effortless
hero.subline: We provide hassle-free car, bike, scooter, and van rentals across Sri Lanka with transparent pricing, verified vehicles, and 24/7 dedicated on-road support.

intro.title: Your Trusted Partner for Sri Lanka Travel
intro.p1: Founded in Kandy & Peradeniya, Danan Car & Bike Rentals has established itself as the leading self-drive and chauffeur vehicle rental service in the hill capital and across Sri Lanka. Whether you're exploring the sacred Temple of the Tooth, ascending Ambuluwawa Tower, or embarking on an island-wide road trip to Nuwara Eliya, Ella, and Sigiriya, our modern fleet ensures a safe, comfortable, and memorable journey.
intro.p2: Our mission is to give every traveler complete freedom of movement with 200 free kilometers per day, transparent pricing with zero hidden fees, and dedicated 24/7 customer support.
